notes.title: Neverending Nightmares 1.4 release notes
notes.content:
In Neverending Nightmares 1.4, we finally fixed the rendering problems for people with older Intel Integrated Graphics hardware including the Mobile Intel(R) 4 Series Express Chipset Family. This means the player will no longer appear black and the shading effect missing. If you are still having issues, please contact us at help@infinitapgames.com

Thank you for your patience with us to sort out this rendering issue!

notes.title: Halloween Sale and more languages added!
notes.content:
Firstly, we are pleased to announce our participation in Steam's Halloween sale. The game is 25% off until November 3rd 10 am Pacific. 

We are even MORE pleased to announce Russian and Swedish localizations of the game are available in the 1.3 build of Neverending Nightmares. We hope to spread nightmares worldwide, so hopefully, we can add even more languages in subsequent versions. If you'd like to do a fan translation, feel free to contact me at translate@infinitapgames.com. It's around 500 words, so it isn't a huge effort.  

1.3 also features fixes another issue with the achievements that wasn't in the original 1.2 build.  

Thank you so much for your support!
